scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release-apk: npm run sync:android && node scripts/check-release-signing.mjs && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:release-bundle: npm run sync:android && node scripts/check-release-signing.mjs && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
